title: Lighting (map/war3map.w3l.json)
description: The project form of war3map.w3l, written by the format definition crates/w3proj/formats/lights.json. Keys the definition doesn't know are allowed: the codec ignores them (they don't reach the packed map).

terrainModel.description: the edited terrain lighting model in the map, empty for the tileset's

unitModel.description: the edited unit lighting model in the map, empty for the tileset's

f32.description: a 32-bit float: a number, or "f32:0x" and its 8 hex digits (NaN and infinities keep their bits that way)

cstring.description: a zero-terminated string; it can't hold the zero character

char.description: one printable ASCII character, or empty for a zero byte

id.description: four bytes: four printable ASCII characters ("hfoo"), or "0x" and 8 hex digits

variant.description: a layout choice the codec made reading the file; it stores no bytes
